note: Two shaded loops of Jeffrey and ponderosa pine and black oak in the Barton Flats area off Hwy 38, about 25 miles from Big Bear Lake; paved, level spurs. Close to the Barton Flats Visitor Center and Greyback Amphitheatre (weekend campfire programs in summer), with the Santa Ana River Trail and the Rio Monte Trail from camp. A dump station is at a nearby campground; firewood sold on site. Bears frequent the area. --Claude
